account.title: Set up Canada Post account
account.description: Sign in once to import the parcels saved in your Canada Post account. Your password is never stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Canada Post sign-in expired
reauth_confirm.description: Canada Post no longer accepts the stored sign-in for {username}. Enter that account's password again.

abort.already_configured: This Canada Post source is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That sign-in is for a different Canada Post account. Sign in with the account this entry was set up for.
abort.two_step_not_supported: This account uses two-step verification, which is not supported. Turn it off for the account, or use tracking codes instead.

error.invalid_auth: Unable to sign in with these credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Canada Post.

data_description.tracking_codes: Canada Post PINs, international tracking numbers, or the number on a delivery notice card (it is converted to the parcel's PIN).

error.invalid_tracking_code: That is not a Canada Post PIN, an international tracking number or a notice card number.
error.not_found: Canada Post has no parcel for that notice card number.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Canada Post.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its Canada Post tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The Canada Post PIN, international tracking number or delivery notice card number.

contents.name: Contents
contents.description: What is in the parcel, in your own words. Calling this again for a tracked parcel replaces it; an empty text clears it.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its Canada Post tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The Canada Post tracking code to stop tracking.

update_contents.name: Update parcel contents
update_contents.description: Set what is in a parcel, in your own words, for a tracking code. An empty text clears it.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The Canada Post PIN or international tracking number of the parcel. A notice card number is not converted here, use the parcel's PIN.

contents.name: Contents
contents.description: What is in the parcel, in your own words. An empty text clears it.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The account to store this for. Needed when no account lists the code yet.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed

update_contents_entry_required.message: No account lists this code. Choose the account to store it for.
